$comment: Max gzip KiB per example production bundle (ADR 0018, gyral-g1r.2). "budgets": all chunks concatenated; "initial": the entry chunk and its static imports, what a page downloads before any import() (gyral-g1r.18); "view": the view layer's client API built with the gyral-compiled condition (scripts/size/view-entry.js). Only ever lower these: pnpm size --check fails above a budget and suggests tightening when a bundle is 0.5 KiB under. Size pass (gyral-g1r.18): every budget is at most measured + 0.1 KiB; hello-world's initial budget is ADR 0018's 9.0 KiB target. The all-chunks budgets of examples that use each(), stores or forms (animated-letters, animation, autocomplete-search, devtools, http-search-github, nested-folders, no-js-first, shared-cart, typeahead-race) stay above their 0.2.0 baseline + 0.1: the lazily loaded hydration and invoker-fallback chunks (about 3.2 KiB gzip, compressed on their own) count there although client-only pages never fetch them; every initial chunk is 2.4-5.4 KiB below its 0.2.0 bundle. Template ids out of production client builds (gyral-g1r.22): every budget set to measured + 0.1 KiB, rounded to 0.1. 0.3.1 size work (gyral-c5d.2, .11-.15): defineDisposableHook (disposal tracking only when imported), spec-field features registered by the build (view transitions, frame lane, custom states), production diagnostics as codes, no property path for props in production, @gyral/time/delay; the budgets raised during 0.3.1 (autocomplete-search, view, isomorphic, no-js-first) are restored and every budget is again measured + 0.1 KiB, rounded to 0.1. "hello-world (clientOnly)" is hello-world built with gyralVitePreset({ clientOnly: true }) (view/07 "Client-only builds"; pnpm size --client-only measures every example that way). Router canonical paths and matcher parity (gyral-dyn.3, ADR 0009 addendum, 0.3.1) raised routing-view and isomorphic by 0.1 KiB. Router scroll and focus after navigation (gyral-dyn.4, ADR 0009 addendum) raised them again (routing-view +0.8 all chunks / +0.3 initial, isomorphic +0.9 / +0.4): settled() and the Navigation API intercept options in the entry, the History API path moved to a lazily loaded tier-3 chunk (ADR 0003) that now carries the scroll and focus steps. CSP-safe style attributes (gyral-dyn.5, view/08) add about 60 B gzip per example (CSSOM writes, static styles as parts, the hydration re-write in the lazy chunk), which put routing-view and isomorphic over by a few bytes once merged with the router changes; each raised by 0.1 KiB. 0.3.1-next.3 (gyral-dyn.25, .26, .27; ADR 0001 "declining parsers" addendum, view/05 "Declining", "Focus", "Prop equality"): parsers that decline let the intent walk continue outward (about 30 B gzip in every app), shadow: { delegatesFocus } is spread into attachShadow (about 10 B), and every prop carries an equals (prop.json compares the JSON; about 25 B in apps with props). Examples that went over by 4-74 B were raised by 0.1 KiB: all-chunks animated-letters, animation, bmi-nested, counter, hello-lastname, http-search-github, nested-folders, no-js-first, register, shared-cart, typeahead-race, undo-replay; initial bmi-nested, devtools, isomorphic, no-js-first, register, routing-view, typeahead-race. The head model (gyral-dyn.9, ADR 0019): routing-view and isomorphic call setHead(), which bundles core's headEntries() normalizer, the router's keyed head applier and scriptSafeJson for JSON-LD (about 0.85 KiB gzip all chunks, 0.7 KiB initial, in apps that call setHead; 0 elsewhere, since setHead() itself puts the applier in the router's slot), plus each example's pageHead(); their budgets are measured + 0.1 KiB.
